sources.title: johnlockejrr/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-HGN · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Native Halogen .hgn weights for halogen-flash-server, converted from the official Hugging Face BF16 snapshot Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. These weights are Halogen’s .hgn format and will not load in Transformers, vLLM, llama.cpp, or similar. They are meant to be mounted into a halogen-flash-server ...

sources.title: bottlecapai/ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ThinkingCap brings our shorter-thinking post-training to Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Qwen Team, 2026), a mixture-of-experts model with image input. ThinkingCap Qwen3.8-Flash-Next cuts reasoning tokens by 38.5% on average (22% to 51% depending on the benchmark) at an average accuracy of 88.8% against the base model's 89.8%. Check our blogpost for more details.
